effectSummary.en: Adds +20%p movement speed for 2 seconds after Retreat Leap lands.

productionConcept: An enduring mobility emblem: a single weathered leather boot with a short silver feather-like wind flourish at the heel. The boot is upright and stable, the broad curved wind form suggests continuing speed after a landing; no ground or leap scene.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone HELLSCRIPT Ranger skill icon. Create one original square 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Style: painterly dark gothic fantasy, worn iron, aged leather, bone and muted bronze, sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, restrained brush texture. Large readable forms, limited detail, strong shape distinction at 64px. Entire subject including glow and particles must fit inside central 76% of canvas, leaving at least 12% fully transparent margin on all four sides. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Use restrained cohesive effects rather than clouds of tiny particles.  Internal identity (do not render text): AP02 Escaping Step. Skill type: passive. Effect: Adds +20%p movement speed for 2 seconds after Retreat Leap lands. Tags: Passive. Linked equipment IDs for identity context only: LA03, LA10, LA23, LA24, LA25, LA26, LA27, LA28. Subject and composition: An enduring mobility emblem: a single weathered leather boot with a short silver feather-like wind flourish at the heel. The boot is upright and stable, the broad curved wind form suggests continuing speed after a landing; no ground or leap scene. FINAL FRAMING REQUIREMENT: a small isolated icon floating in extensive fully transparent empty space. Fit ALL visible content inside a centered square occupying only 60% of total canvas width and height; leave 20% absolutely empty transparent margins. Output resolution must be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels.
